input.text: Continental drift, first proposed by Alfred Wegener in 1912, suggested that continents were once joined in a supercontinent called Pangaea approximately 335 million years ago. Evidence includes matching fossil records across continents, similar rock formations, and the jigsaw-like fit of continental coastlines. This hypothesis was later confirmed and expanded by the theory of plate tectonics.
